user.title: Storage Manager
user.description: Adds a sidebar panel that shows what uses your disk and lets you reclaim space safely. Nothing is deleted without your confirmation.

data.backup_before_delete: Back up before deleting from the database

data_description.low_space_percent: Create a repair issue when free space drops below this share.
data_description.forecast_warning_days: Days until the disk is full according to the growth trend.
data_description.backup_rotation: Delete local backup copies that fall outside the daily/weekly/monthly schedule when you run a cleanup.
data_description.require_offsite: Keep a local copy unless the same backup exists on another location (NAS, cloud).
data_description.backup_before_delete: Before history or statistics are deleted, a backup of Home Assistant with the database is created and verified. A backup with the database from the last six hours is reused.

confirm.title: Safe cleanup
confirm.description:
{free} free ({percent} % of the disk).

This removes local backup copies outside your rotation ({backups}) and regenerable files such as caches and old logs ({files}).

For database cleanup open the [Storage Manager panel]({panel}).

abort.nothing_to_clean: Nothing can be removed safely right now. Open the [Storage Manager panel]({panel}) to shorten the retention of the largest database entities.
